metadata.title: 2 accidental kills and I’m still questioning if Valorant’s physics took a break
metadata.description:
Wait, how did that even hit? Enemy probably wondering if they’re invisible.
My aim was definitely on vacation but somehow scored twice.
Click if your best kills come from complete chaos!

Tap if your aim’s mostly ‘wait how did that happen?’ moments!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
